name: labs/opntec__open-spectrometer-python
title: TCD1304 linear CCD on a PSLab (open-spectrometer-python)
intro: TCD1304 linear CCD on a PSLab (open-spectrometer-python), adapted from opntec/open-spectrometer-python. It reads `master_clock_frequency`; sets `integration_time`; runs `measure_intensity` and `power_on`. `measure_intensity`: measure optical or radiant intensity at a declared wavelength or channel and return the value with its unit and integration time. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
